changeSet.author: mrowe-tan
changeSet.comment: Record the requested sample's owner at the time a SampleRequest was raised, so the request's history stays accurate even after a later ownership transfer (RSDEV-1309). Added nullable first so existing rows can be backfilled from the sample's current owner (the closest available approximation for a pre-existing request), then made not-null to match requesterUsername.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE SampleRequest sr JOIN Sample s ON sr.sample_id = s.id JOIN User u ON s.owner_id = u.id SET sr.originalOwner = u.username WHERE sr.originalOwner IS NULL;
